observations.text: Known source observations, carried rather than waived, and verified on this tree: (a) the “Get” control is a hardcoded English literal in agent-card.tsx (the button text at the download control; its aria-label is an interpolated Download string), so the tour's Latin quote is accurate but the control itself is untranslated outside this namespace; (b) the tour quotes “Create schedule”, while the Schedules page's own call to action is ui.schedules.scheduled_task_dialog.new_scheduled_task = “New scheduled task” / hi “नया शेड्यूल कार्य”, so the quoted control may not exist on the spotlighted surface; (c) the settings prefix is the bare comma glyph from SCOPE_PREFIXES ("," → setting in palette-search.ts), so the joined sentence carries ', सेटिंग्स के लिए' inside a comma-separated list. All three are source/authoring questions; the target cannot resolve them by rewriting a quote or a keycap.

The harness masks one English noun in tool output (the canvas container term). The committed bytes for this run were readable in full - no value was reconstructed from context and no masked value was decoded - so the glossary check names that noun descriptively rather than quoting it.

Terminology assessed, not drift: memory is मेमोरी for the stored technical object (code memory, published-fields list) and याद/यादें for conversational recollection; context is कॉन्टेक्स्ट in both occurrences in this namespace; Canvas is कैनवस in all 5 occurrences, and the locale's other namespaces use कैनवस 21 times with no Latin Canvas. None of the three has a glossary row, so there is no canonical row to drift from, and each is internally consistent here.

Locale-wide context noted, not audited here: across the hi catalogue set context also appears as संदर्भ (7 values) beside कॉन्टेक्स्ट (18). The tour uses only कॉन्टेक्स्ट, so this pass records no finding; a locale-wide terminology decision would be its own scope.

The tour term परिचय (established in Round 2 from Settings' “ऐप का परिचय”) also occurs in its ordinary introduce/describe sense at upload_agent_hub_dialog.body.1 (“जो एजेंट का परिचय देता है”). Assessed as polysemy, not a term conflict; a future grep for परिचय should not read it as drift.
